interpretation.label: mech074_readwrite_head_two_route_separability_supports

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::n_traces_sufficient
preconditions.description: Exploration buffer holds enough traces for a weighted sample.
preconditions.control: collect phase alternating threat/neutral, one trace per episode

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::gt_arousal_spread
preconditions.description: Std of the harness ground-truth arousal label across buffer traces. This is the SAME statistic every criterion routes on: all four AORs are differences of means of gt_arousal, so a zero-spread label forces every AOR to 0 no matter how the sample is weighted.
preconditions.control: threat/neutral alternation gives high- and low-arousal episodes

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::buffer_gt_alignment
preconditions.description: Harness gt_arousal list length equals the buffer length, so label index i really is trace i. Misalignment would silently scramble the DV.
preconditions.control: one flush per episode, verified by buffer growth at each agent.reset()

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::strength_route_nonuniform
preconditions.description: memory_strength range across buffer traces. The write-STRENGTH route can only move a weighted sample if encoding_gain actually varies trace to trace.
preconditions.control: threat episodes cross the BLA arousal threshold and elevate the gain

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::address_route_nonuniform
preconditions.description: retrieval_bias range across buffer traces, taken from the REAL BLA output. The write-ADDRESS route can only move a weighted sample if the per-trace bias vector actually varies.
preconditions.control: threat episodes write a non-zero arousal_tag; neutral episodes write 0

interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff C1 AND C4, where C4 = (C2 AND C3). Each criterion is met when it holds on >= SEEDS_PASS_MIN of the seeds. C4 (separability) is the load-bearing criterion for the PARENT claim MECH-074; C3 alone is MECH-074a and C2 alone is MECH-074b.
